cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Choose the Relationship
cards.instruction: Make someone prioritize this connection over a competing person, promise, or opportunity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Let work ring. I'd like to finish choosing our wedding vows with you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The client won't sign unless I'm there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I'm about to promise you my whole life. Could I have ten minutes before the client?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll ask Maya to cover. She'll want a reason.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell her we're making promises too. Put ours in your calendar beside the client's.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the soup. You may start lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was asking whether you'd pass the salt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request is under consideration.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get it myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent initiative. Approved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Welcome to my garage sale. Your offer to browse is accepted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's my garage. You're helping.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you're doing very well under my supervision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm going inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Granted. Take five.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let work ring. I'd like to finish choosing our wedding vows with you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The client won't sign unless I'm there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm about to promise you my whole life. Could I have ten minutes before the client?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll ask Maya to cover. She'll want a reason.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell her we're making promises too. Put ours in your calendar beside the client's.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay home from the networking dinner. I've finally learned your mother's dumplings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The director's coming. I could get promoted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then staying would tell me I'm more than the person keeping dinner warm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Freeze them. We'll have them tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's what you said on our anniversary. Call and say you've already got dinner with me.

cards.title: Remember Me Correctly
cards.instruction: Create small tests of whether someone remembers your preferences, stories, or shared history.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before you take the tea through, which cup is mine?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you just take one? Everyone's waiting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Twelve years of breakfast together. Which one have I always used?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The blue one. Your name's underneath.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Correct, but turn it upright. How much milk? I haven't written that on the handle.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the soup. You may start lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was asking whether you'd pass the salt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request is under consideration.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get it myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent initiative. Approved.

beats.text: Welcome to my garage sale. Your offer to browse is accepted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's my garage. You're helping.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm going inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Granted. Take five.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you caption our holiday photo, what did I say when we missed that boat?

beats.text: I'll start you off: 'Well, that's the last time we trust...'

beats.text: Can I just write 'Happy memories'?

beats.text: Let's try multiple choice. Your watch, my French, or the man selling us watches?

cards.title: Let Go of the Grudge
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender resentment, distance, or a claim that keeps the relationship stuck.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Come sit beside me at dinner. I know you're still angry I missed your opening night.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You left that seat empty. You can have an empty one tonight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I deserved that last night. Could tonight's seat have you in it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm still going to tell you what you missed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please do. Move your plate over; I want to hear every scene.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the soup. You may start lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was asking whether you'd pass the salt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request is under consideration.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get it myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent initiative. Approved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Welcome to my garage sale. Your offer to browse is accepted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's my garage. You're helping.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm going inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Granted. Take five.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me help you move. Missing your birthday shouldn't mean I'm banned from every box.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I needed you then. You didn't show.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know. I'm here now. Give me one thing you can bear to trust me with.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The birthday glasses. Still wrapped, since nobody came.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll carry them carefully. Could we unwrap two at your new place?

cards.title: I Pulled Away First
cards.instruction: Hide your role in creating the distance while working urgently to repair it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before your taxi comes, let's restart our letters. I've brought paper and stamps.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You never answered my last three.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. The post's been terrible. We can write the first ones here, bypass the whole system.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I handed you the last one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even better. Sit down; I'll write yours first. You can watch until there's enough to take home.

cards.instruction: Keep the conversation away from the real reason the relationship changed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I've brought the picnic basket. Same sandwiches as our last afternoon here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The afternoon you said we needed space?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. We've got more space under that tree. Shall we move the blanket?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Moving won't stop me asking why.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then stay here. You always had strong views about mustard; tell me if I've finally got it right.
